purpose: Operationalize the parent AI-Core eligibility temporal rule so a newly observed positive evidence event cannot contaminate the same trading date.
authoritative_observation_time: GitHub committed_at of the first prospective evidence-event commit.

effective_date_rule.default: Convert authoritative observation time to Asia/Shanghai calendar date O. The earliest eligible signal date is the first joint A-share trading date D such that D > O.
effective_date_rule.weekend_or_holiday: Advance to the first later joint trading date.
effective_date_rule.reason: Conservative no-leakage interpretation of 'first trading date after authoritative repository observation time'; avoids dependence on intraday publication/commit timing.

revision_rule: A new official filing revision creates a new evidence event and can alter state only from its own separately computed effective date.
